metadata.description: AXON — zero-downtime deployment orchestration CLI. Plugin to install the AXON binary and set up deployments interactively from Claude Code.

plugins.name: axon
plugins.description: Install the AXON CLI via /axon:install, update it via /axon:update, scaffold deployments via /axon:config, and operate them via the axon-ops skill (deploy/rollback/status/logs/health/restart). Includes the axon-config skill: full axon.config.yml schema, docker/static modes, env-var expansion, and validation.
